Meet the community ↓
About / Our common ground

A shared rhythm.
A familiar ritual.
A reason to come together.

The Coffee Party brings people together through coffee, music and daytime gatherings. The cup is a conversation starter. The music gives us something to share. The people make it a party.

Come with friends or come on your own. There’s room to find your rhythm, meet someone new and make a little more of your day.

Join the party ↗
More than a morning out

Come for the coffee.
Stay for the people.

We like the idea that an everyday ritual can open the door to something unexpected: a new conversation, a favourite track, a face you’ll recognise next time.

A good gathering can be the starting point for a bigger idea. Coffee, creativity and collaboration give us plenty of places to begin.

Our projects ↗
Local people. Shared energy.

Our cities.
Our gatherings.
Our community.

Every gathering starts somewhere: a coffee counter, a local space, a room brought to life by the people in it. We want each Coffee Party to feel connected to its surroundings.

Confirmed cities and local networks will appear as they’re announced. Explore the events preview or find the city-based signup below.

Communities built by Coffee Party

Five gatherings we’ve built with the community, newest first. Photos are still to come.

[01 / Sep 2026]

Morning Movement
at Western.

Pilates set to a live DJ, with coffee, matcha and a wellness market. It opened a university series with Nutratology and Western’s student council.

[02 / Jun 20, 2026]

Wellness Wonderland
at Cabana Pool Bar.

A waterfront day with rooftop Pilates from Solis Movement, beauty and activewear brands, an Organika electrolyte bar, Ultra Violette SPF and DJ Sistek.

[03 / Apr 19, 2026]

Raptors
playoff kickoff.

A free party in a private space inside Scotiabank Arena, with cold brew, pastries, DJs and playoff giveaways.

[04 / Sep 2025]

Soho House.
No phones.

The first phone-free Coffee Party, built around being present with each other. It was also the first public pour of Coffee Party Cold Brew.

[05 / Jun 12, 2025]

Vassnova
at CASA SEAT.

The first European Coffee Party, with Viviana Casanova’s Vassnova label during OFF Week in Barcelona. DJs included Dosem and Ivox García, alongside Reebok and Red Bull.
